problems: The Elenchus cut is damaged: it is a two-column list read across, so some author heads/titles are torn (Leo Grammaticus, Joannes Presbyter, Epiphanius, Michael Cerularius lines) and the numbers for the last authors are detached ('1039 1051 / 1075 1197 / 1119 / 1239 1289'); the mapping of those to titles is inferred from the body (entries marked).

Page numbers are often lost or garbled (e.g. '663' for 603, '110' for 710, '1903' for 1203); every column rests on the nearest surviving page header and on the Ordo rerum. Title blocks often precede the page header in the OCR (Edictum, Leo Achridanus, Joannes diaconus), which I took to mean they belong to the page whose header follows.

Entries not listed in the Elenchus but present in the body and Ordo were left out: Commentarius praevius (col 9), Notitia/Testimonia on Epiphanius (cols 179-183), Notitia on Michael Cerularius (716), Samonas Notitia (819), Leo Achridanus Notitia (833), Nicetas Pectoratus Notitiae/Monitum (844-851), Humberti Responsio (1021), Notitia ex Fabricio (1046), Epigrammata quinque (1199), Notitia on Xiphilinus.
The Carmen iambicum in Symeonem Juniorem is only a stub in the body ('Vide supra col. 307'), and the Elenchus's placement of it is unclear; recorded as an internal crossref with bodyCol null.
Alexius CP crossref in the Elenchus reads 'tom. CXII, col. 745' but the body stub says 'tom. CXIX ... col. 743'; Demetrius says 'col. 1008' vs body '1098-1115'. Both recorded as read, not corrected.
Nicetas Chartophylax (Elenchus 715 vs body 711) and Nicetas Pectoratus (Elenchus 954 vs first head 851) are real disagreements; both explained in notes.
